name: To the Top
summary: Marli Wishrunner can send you up to see the sights from one of the twin colossals of Feralas, with a warning attached: the trip goes only one way.

sections.title: One Way Up
sections.body: Marli Wishrunner asks whether you would like to see the view from the top of one of the twin colossals, and can send you there. Marli adds a word of caution: think about how you will get down, because this is a one-way trip.

faq.q: Who can send you to the top of a colossal?
faq.answer: Marli Wishrunner can send you up to a view from one of the twin colossals.
To the top of one of the twin colossals.

faq.q: Does Marli provide a way back down?
faq.answer: No. Marli warns that it is a one-way trip, so you should think about how you will get down.
